summary: Attendance schedule and late-classification accuracy fix.
changelog: Default work schedule is 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM for all employees until HR publishes the 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM exception list.
Daily Dashboard and Attendance Review now use the same schedule-rule source.
A missing AM punch or PM-only punch is classified for review instead of being counted as late.
AM late minutes are recalculated from the valid/effective morning punch against the 8:30 AM default.
PM late minutes are counted only when the attendance engine has a valid LATE_PM interpretation.
Daily Dashboard shows a Needs Review count and list for incomplete punch pairing.
